title: psila spartioides
intro: Psila spartioides, commonly known as Greek chamomile or Sparta chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its calming and soothing properties, which have made it a popular herb in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Psila spartioides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Psila spartioides include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, such as apigenin and luteolin, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedation, anti-anxiety effects, and skin-soothing properties.
